crossRefs.note: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what…
But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of…
brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness…

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

translations.web: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
translations.bsb: Then I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ ‘Get up and go into Damascus,’ He told me. ‘There you will be told all that you have been appointed to do.’
translations.kjv: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
translations.asv: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
